title: Election analyst Ivan Shukshin says Moscow precinct results are being rewritten after Russia’s State Duma election
text: Election analyst Ivan Shukshin said tally sheets containing the results of Russia’s State Duma elections were being rewritten “on a large scale” in Moscow. As one example, Shukshin pointed to a tally sheet from polling station No. 2700 in western Moscow that he said an election commission member had to “fight” to obtain. The original tally showed United Russia with 21.5% of the vote at the polling station, the Communist Party with 28.2%, and New People with 29.5%. But those figures changed in the final version entered into the Central Election Commission’s system: United Russia had 86.8% of the vote, the Communist Party had 2.5%, and New People had 2%. Shukshin said the tally was uploaded to the GAS Vybory platform overnight on September 20–21 but did not appear on the Central Election Commission’s website until the afternoon of September 22 — a day and a half later. “It takes five minutes to publish a tally sheet, not a day and a half!” he said. “Why am I writing that it’s happening on a large scale? Because territorial election commissions in different Moscow districts are accepting revised tally sheets [from precinct election commissions] [with rewritten vote totals],” Shukshin

title: EU Removes Billionaires Usmanov and Fridman From Sanctions List
text: EU Removes Billionaires Usmanov and Fridman From Sanctions List By Reuters Sep. 22, 2026 Alisher Usmanov and Mikhail Fridman. © Marie-Lan Nguyen; LetterOne Group EU envoys agreed to drop billionaires Alisher Usmanov and Mikhail Fridman from its Russia n sanctions list and to roll over the remaining 3,000 individuals and entities for another three years, EU diplomats said on Tuesday. EU envoys had earlier agreed to remove the Usmanov and Fridman in exchange for a three-year renewal, but Latvia was the last hold-out in an unusually fraught process. Sanctions require unanimity among EU countries to be approved. Latvia ultimately abstained, diplomats said, which allowed the deal to pass. The decision will only be formally adopted once a process known as a written procedure has been completed. France surprised other EU members earlier this month when it pushed for Usmanov, a Russia n-Uzbek metals tycoon, to be removed from EU sanctions, citing national security concerns. Luxembourg then demanded the same treatment for Fridman, who has launched a $16 billion claim against the country. title: Czech Man Jailed 13 Days for Red Square Protest
text: Czech Man Jailed 13 Days for Red Square Protest Sep. 22, 2026 Lenin’s Mausoleum on Red Square in Moscow. Yuri D.K. (CC BY 4.0) A judge at Moscow’s Tverskoy District Court sentenced a Czech man to 13 days in jail on Tuesday for staging a protest on Red Square. Identified as Michal Plamenek, the man was arrested for holding up a sign in English next to Lenin’s Mausoleum on Sunday afternoon, the court ’s press service said in a statement. No details were provided as to what was written on Plamenek’s sign, but the court press service said a judge ruled that the inscription was “aimed at discrediting the Russian Armed Forces.” Police officers arrested Plamenek because Red Square directly adjoins the Kremlin, where protests are banned. He allegedly refused to listen to a request by officers to accompany them to a police station and resisted arrest. A judge found Plamenek guilty on three separate administrative counts of discrediting the Russian military, violating protest rules and disobeying a police officer. The judge fined Plamenek 40,000 rubles ($470) for the first violation, 20,000 rubles ($237) for the second and handed him a sentence of 13 days in jail for the third. Read more abo

title: What Could the ‘Super’ El Niño Bring to Russia?
text: What Could the ‘Super’ El Niño Bring to Russia? By Mack Tubridy Sep. 22, 2026 Bone remains of a dead cow pictured at the village of Los Piches in Honduras on Sept. 4, 2026. Animals are dropping dead amid the worst drought in living memory for many Central Americans who are grappling with the unforgiving effects of El Niño. Orlando Sierra / AFP UN Secretary-General António Guterres warned earlier this summer that “El Niño is being supersized before our eyes” and called on countries to end their dependency on planet-heating fossil fuels. “The world must treat it as the urgent climate warning it is. El Niño conditions will pour fuel on the fire of a warming world. Impacts will hit even harder, travel even farther, and cross borders with devastating speed,” Guterres said. But a very strong El Niño does not mean that every region will be hit with equal force. So how will Russia fare? El Niño involves the heating of the central and eastern equatorial Pacific Ocean. It happens every few years and is part of a natural climate cycle that alternates between a warm phase — El Niño — and a cool phase, known as La Niña. title: Shopping Center Fire in Bashkortostan Kills 4
text: Shopping Center Fire in Bashkortostan Kills 4 Sep. 22, 2026 A fire at a shopping center in Sterlitamak on Sept. 22, 2026. Russian Emergencies Ministry At least four people were killed in a fire that broke out at a shopping center in the city of Sterlitamak in Russia’s republic of Bashkortostan, emergency services told state news agencies on Tuesday afternoon. The Emergency Situations Ministry said the blaze erupted at the Solnechny shopping center at around noon local time and spread across 2,100 square meters (22,600 square feet) before firefighters contained it by 2 p.m. It said emergency crews rescued 17 people from the building, including a child. Sterlitamak is located 1,150 kilometers (715 miles) east of Moscow. Videos and photos shared online showed smoke and flames billowing from the four-story brick building. One video showed a person jumping from the building onto a crowd below to escape the fire. Regional health officials said four people were hospitalized for injuries, including three women and a 16-year-old girl. One of the women remains in critical condition, they added. A short circuit is suspected as the preliminary cause of the fire, sources told the news agency RI

title: One Killed as Ukraine Strikes Refineries in Samara and Bashkortostan
text: One Killed as Ukraine Strikes Refineries in Samara and Bashkortostan Sep. 22, 2026 A photo purportedly showing a large, black smoke cloud rising above the Kuibyshev refinery on Sep. 22, 2026. t.me/supernova_plus At least one person was killed and 15 others were injured during overnight Ukrainian drone attacks across Russia, local officials said Tuesday, with Ukraine’s military reporting that it struck an oil refinery in the southern Samara region. Samara region Governor Vyacheslav Fedorishchev wrote in a post on Telegram that one person was killed and four others were wounded in what he described as a “treacherous” Ukrainian strike. He did not provide any details about the victims or say where the attack took place. The Ukrainian military said it struck the Rosneft-operated Kuibyshev refinery, located southwest of Samara’s regional capital. The facility has been targeted multiple times throughout the war. Fedorishchev did not mention the refinery in his Telegram post, mentioning only that “the enemy was targeting industrial enterprises.” Videos and images shared on social media purportedly showed a large, black smoke cloud rising above the Kuibyshev refinery early Tuesday. title: Australia news live: Joyce says One Nation talking to Coalition about power-sharing agreement; fog causes Sydney airport delays
text: 18.35 EDT Joyce speaking with ‘very, very senior Liberals’ about power-sharing deal Sarah Basford Canales Barnaby Joyce says he’s been in talks with “very, very senior Liberals” over a power-sharing arrangement should One Nation win enough seats at the next federal election. Speaking to News24 yesterday afternoon, the Nationals-turned-One Nation MP said there would be an expectation that the Coalition and the minor party would work together if they had the numbers to beat the Albanese government at the polls. I think we’ve been pretty clear on this. We’ve said our job is to get rid of the socialists. So either we would offer supply and confidence to the Coalition … on the premise of solid policy outcomes that we would want for that to happen, and we would want there to be clear acknowledgment that they are our policy outcomes, and we’d have a regime then of looking at legislation that came forward … we’d expect the same deal if we had greater numbers than the Coalition. Joyce said he’d had discussions with “very, very senior Liberals” as recently as Tuesday morning on a possible deal. He added “we’re now cutting dice, and we’ll find out where we end up”. title: Trump defends actions in Iran and Venezuela in UN General Assembly address amid rising tensions with allies – live
text: 11.36 EDT Trump's UN remarks - in summary Trump opened his speech to the UN by commemorating the nation’s 250th anniversary and focusing not on international issues, but touting his domestic record. Tax cuts, stock market highs, crime rates, and immigration enforcement, to name a few. He once again framed the war he launched on Iran earlier this year with Israel the same way he has to his domestic audience — as a necessary conflict to addressing a long-ignored threat. The United States, Trump said, had acted to prevent Iran from obtaining a nuclear weapon, while other countries ignored the issue. Trump then re-issued his threat to “annihilate” Iran and “drive them into Hell” if the regime didn’t capitulate and make a deal.” He touted his version of the war: one in which the US had defanged Iran militarily and driven the country to the brink of economic collapse. And hedged by saying he was confident Iran would make a deal after the US midterm elections – an argument he’s made to US voters. Trump said he was “working closely with the leaders of Russia and Ukraine” to end the disastrous war. “It’s going to happen, I think, more quickly than people understand,” he said. The US preside

text: 🎙 Интервью заместителя Министра иностранных дел России А.С.Алимова МИА «Россия сегодня» (22 сентября 2026 года) ❓ Вопрос: Определилась ли Россия с поддержкой кандидата на пост Генерального секретаря ООН? 💬 А.С.Алимов: Отбор и назначение высшего административного должностного лица ООН – процедура многосложная . От предпочтений отдельно взятого государства – пусть даже постоянного члена Совета Безопасности, как в случае с Россией – результат, несомненно, зависит, но лишь отчасти . Скажу больше, в современных реалиях острой геополитической напряжённости публично озвученные предпочтения того или иного государства в конечном счёте могут сыграть не в пользу кандидата . <...> В текущем избирательном цикле очередь выдвигать кандидата, согласно неофициальному принципу географической ротации, перешла к региону Латинской Америки и Карибского бассейна . Несмотря на то, что это правило ранее уже нарушалось – уроженец Португалии А.Гутерреш занял свою нынешнюю должность десять лет назад вместо представителя восточноевропейской группы – мы публично заявили о приверженности указанному принципу. text: Продвижение под Добропольем Группировка войск «Центр» развивает наступление на Добропольском направлении . В Минобороны России отчитались об окружении группировки противника в важном узле обороны, обозначив успехи по нарушению снабжения украинских формирований, удерживающих Доброполье . Как и остальные группировки российских войск, «Центр» действует силами малых групп: двойки и тройки штурмовиков глубоко проходят в разросшуюся «серую зону». Есть сообщения о выходе российских бойцов в район Веровки западнее Святогоровки , а также о просачивании к Белозерскому , Водяному и Новотроицкому . Порой в одной лесополосе, в соседних блиндажах, могут сидеть малые группы как российских бойцов, так и противника, не имея возможности высунуться из-за дронов и вступить в стрелковый бой. Часто в такой ситуации решает только число дронов у поддерживающих операторов и то, в насколько глубоком блиндаже удалось укрыться. В относительно тыловых районах продолжается зачистка. За последние недели российские бойцы укрепили позиции в Светлом , окрестностях Белицкого и Родинского , заняв и зачистив опорные пункты противника. Есть тактические успехи и на рубеже Матяшево — Васильевка , где бойцы ВС РФ продвига
author: Boris Rozhin

text: О «инфильтрационной» тактике противника. Опираясь на успешный опыт ВС РФ в применении малых высокомобильных штурмовых групп и ДРГ, действующих в межпозиционном пространстве противника, ВСУ приступили к введению похожей тактики. Разведка противника выявляет наименее укрепленные участки фронта, после чего в ближний тыл проникают малочисленные тактические группы для выполнения рейдовых, диверсионных и штурмовых задач, в том числе с целью захвата ценной документации, электронных устройств с актуальными картами и действующих средств специальной связи. В числе прочего в ходе выполнения таких задач противник уделяет большое внимание захвату пленных, чтобы выявить среди них наиболее слабых в психологическом и волевом отношении людей и использовать последних в качестве так называемых «отмычек» — источников информации о расположении позиций, командных пунктов, огневых точек и скрытых засад. Кроме того, таких людей предполагается задействовать в качестве проводников. К такому «сотрудничеству» принуждают угрозами, физическим истязанием, а также обещанием быстрого включения в списки обмена. При этом в подавляющем большинстве случаев согласившегося на сотрудничество уничтожают на месте после вып
author: Boris Rozhin

text: Ми з Президентом Трампом і нашими командами обговорили, як закінчити війну. Це пріоритет. Ми готові. Не впевнений, чи Росія на сьогодні готова, але в будь-якому разі ми обговорили енергетичне перемир’я. Ми готові до енергетичного перемир’я, якщо вони не атакуватимуть нашу енергетику, наші електромережі, систему опалення та водопостачання. Це наша пропозиція. Ми вдячні американській стороні. Вони передадуть її росіянам. Я не знаю позиції Росії. Завтра Президент Трамп зустрінеться з лідером Китаю. Я дуже відверто сказав Президенту, що ми вважаємо: якщо він також залучить Президента Сі – він має вплив на Путіна. Якщо ми хочемо закінчити цю війну не лише на словах, то всі маємо працювати над цим цілодобово – заради людей. Ми також говорили про зиму. Це важливо на шляху до переговорів. Ми маємо підготуватися. Це буде нелегко. Ми просимо американську сторону про дві речі. Перше – це зимовий пакет ракет для «петріотів». Друге – це ліцензії на виробництво ракет для «петріотів». Нам також потрібні гарантії безпеки для України. author: President of Ukraine

text: Подякував Прем’єр-міністерці Санае Такаїчі під час нашої зустрічі за міцну підтримку Японії протягом усіх цих років російської війни: енергетичні пакети, санкційні рішення та гуманітарні проєкти. І дуже важливо було почути, що допомога продовжиться. Обговорили напрями, де можемо бути корисні одне одному. Звісно, Україна готова ділитися своїм досвідом і технологіями на взаємовигідній основі. Японія також має сильні технології для захисту життя, передусім у ППО, які можуть допомогти Україні пройти наступну зиму, якщо Росія вкотре відкине перемовини. Запросив пані Прем’єр-міністерку відвідати Україну, і зокрема Києво-Печерську лавру, яку Японія допомагала відновлювати після жорстокого дронового удару росіян. Вдячний за лідерство у допомозі заради захисту життів в Україні. Дякую, Японіє!

title: Ukraine anger as EU removes Russian oligarchs from sanctions list

France had campaigned for Russian-Uzbek billionaire Alisher Usmanov to be taken off the list, citing "national security concerns". Luxembourg called for the removal of Russian-Israeli businessman Mikhail Fridman, who is suing the country for the release of frozen assets. Latvia initially opposed the deal but agreed to a compromise, part of which involved extending sanctions on nearly 3,000 other individuals and entities for three years. title: Six-year-old Chinese girl ‘sets new women’s Rubik’s Cube world record’
text: 0:56 Six-year-old breaks women's world Rubik's Cube record – video Puzzle games Six-year-old Chinese girl ‘sets new women’s Rubik’s Cube world record’ Lian Yunzhi solves 3x3 puzzle on several occasions in average time of under 4.5 seconds, according to state media Agence France-Presse in Beijing Tue 22 Sep 2026 14.10 EDT Last modified on Tue 22 Sep 2026 16.19 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google A six-year-old Chinese girl has set a new women’s world record for solving a Rubik’s Cube in just over four seconds, state media reported. “Speedcuber” Lian Yunzhi broke the women’s 3x3 average world record twice this month at two World Cube Association certified competitions in Wuhan and Guangzhou, according to state broadcaster CCTV on Monday. She posted averages of 4.52 and 4.27 seconds, after solving the Rubik’s Cube five times. The girl, who is from Chengdu, is “the first female speedcuber to average under 4.5 seconds”, CCTV said. A video posted by the broadcaster showed her wearing a red gingham bow on her head as she deftly turned and twisted a Rubik’s Cube. After solving the puzzle she was seen placing the cube on the table, clapping her hands and pumping a fist in the air. Nickn
author: Agence France-Presse in Beijing

title: Ukraine anger as EU removes Russian oligarchs from sanctions list
text: Ukraine anger as EU removes Russian oligarchs from sanctions list Image source, Reuters Image caption, Usmanov is described as having particularly close ties to President Putin By Robert Greenall Published 22 September 2026 The European Union is to remove sanctions on two oligarchs imposed after Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, according to reports, prompting anger in Ukraine. France had campaigned for Russian-Uzbek billionaire Alisher Usmanov to be taken off the list, citing "national security concerns". Luxembourg called for the removal of Russian-Israeli businessman Mikhail Fridman, who is suing the country for the release of frozen assets. Latvia initially opposed the deal but agreed to a compromise, part of which involved extending sanctions on nearly 3,000 other individuals and entities for three years. Ukrainian officials said the move was "unacceptable" and sent the wrong signal to Moscow. "Moscow is celebrating because it got what it wanted: a sense of impunity, the humiliation of the EU, and division among Europeans," Foreign Minister Andriy Sybiha said on X. He urged all EU member states to instead announce national sanctions on the two individuals. Latvi

title: Watch: Ukraine's race to counter new jet-powered Russian drones
text: Watch: Ukraine's race to counter new jet-powered Russian drones Watch: Ukraine's race to counter new jet-powered Russian drones Close Russian attacks on Ukraine are becoming more devastating than before because of their new jet-powered drones, which are harder to shoot down. Russia launched nearly 3,000 of these new drones in August alone and while Kyiv has used missiles and fighter jets to fight against them, it is proving too expensive. Ukraine is now in a race to develop low-cost weapons that can counter them. The BBC's Abdujalil Abdurasulov spoke with Ukrainian air defence units about how they are fighting against this new threat.
